public_rationale: For January–March 2026, Microsoft reported an annual AI revenue run rate above $37 billion, and Amazon reported one above $15 billion. These disclosures establish the revenue numerators but do not supply matching cumulative capital-expenditure denominators to reproduce either 6% ratio. [e1, e2] Oracle's March 10, 2026 results attributed most of its quarterly backlog increase to large AI contracts. This challenges the exclusion of other competitive AI businesses, but does not establish a comparable market-wide test of competitiveness. [e3]
limitations: The packet does not establish cumulative capex starting dates, finance-lease treatment, or allocation between AI and other activities. [e1, e2]
Oracle's disclosure concerns contracts and backlog; it does not provide the independent market comparison required to settle exclusivity. [e3]

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Outside OpenAI and Anthropic, the only other competitive AI businesses are those of Amazon, Microsoft and Google, two of which now have annualized AI revenues of around 6% of their capital expenditures so far.

statement.excerpt: Outside of those two, the only other competitive AI businesses are those of Amazon, Microsoft and Google — two of which now have annualized AI revenues of around 6% of their capital expenditures so far.
statement.document_title: Am I Meant To Be Impressed?

from_speaker: the only other competitive AI businesses
our_interpretation: The two companies with disclosed ratios are Amazon and Microsoft, as identified in the surrounding discussion.
The numerator is annualized AI revenue, not realized annual revenue or monthly revenue.
The ordinary reading of competitive is a commercially substantial AI business. The speaker supplies no market-share or profitability threshold.
Use January–March 2026, the latest reported quarter before publication, for the current revenue snapshots. The starting date and coverage of cumulative capital expenditure remain unspecified.
The surrounding discussion calls the expenditure AI capex, but that does not establish that all company capital expenditure was attributable to AI.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable disclosures establish approximately 6% for both companies using identifiable cumulative capital-expenditure windows, and market evidence supports the claimed exclusion of other competitive AI businesses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reproducible calculation materially differs from approximately 6% for either company, or a clearly comparable business outside the named five meets the ordinary competitive-business reading.
